items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: He said, this is for Chucky.

ctx.x: No, he did everything. But a lot of the numbers that they whipped up, they took old classical folk songs and all sorts of things and changed them over.

Last time I saw Bowlin, King Bowlin, I saw him at Masonic Hall. And he had a little trouble. I would stay there until the dance was over on a Monday night. And they shot... They'd spent all the deposit he'd receive on engagement. And when they paid him the rest, he'd had enough money to finish paying the boys, you know. So he started issuing it out. He said, yeah, it was your Colorado boys. He looked at that and he had 60 cents left. He said, this is for Chucky. No one gonna get this for Chucky. And he's Chucky.…
